CustomField.label: Age Years
CustomField.description: Calculates customer age in years based on date of birth.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Calculates customer age in years based on date of birth.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Date_Of_Birth__c), 0, YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(Date_Of_Birth__c) - IF(OR(MONTH(TODAY()) < MONTH(Date_Of_Birth__c), AND(MONTH(TODAY()) = MONTH(Date_Of_Birth__c), DAY(TODAY()) < DAY(Date_Of_Birth__c))), 1, 0))
